description: Search live Skyscanner (skyscanner.pl) fares for a one-way or round trip: the itineraries Skyscanner ranks best — total price in PLN, airlines, per-leg local times, duration, stops, self-transfer flag and a booking link — plus the cheapest and fastest fare across the whole search. The results page is rendered live through a paid unblocker, so a call takes ~20–40 s; finished searches are cached for 5 minutes. `search_complete: false` means Skyscanner was still collecting prices when the page was captured (calling again usually returns the finished search). For stop/time/airline filters or other currencies use google_flights_search. Result shape: { source, fetched_at, query, trip_type, search_url, currency, search_complete, providers_checked, providers_total, total_results, summary: { best, cheapest, fastest } (each { price_per_person, duration_minutes }), count, itineraries: [...], note } — the list key is `itineraries`, never `flights` or `results`. Each itinerary: { price, price_per_person, currency, airlines, legs: [...], self_transfer, offers_count, url }; each leg: { origin, origin_name, destination, destination_name, departure, arrival, duration_minutes, stops, stopovers, airlines, change_airport }. `price` is a number — the total for all passengers and both directions, taxes included; `price_per_person` is the fare per passenger; `departure`/`arrival` are local times 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM'; a round trip has two legs (outbound, then return) under one price.

destination.description: Destination: IATA airport code (e.g. LHR, BCN) or Skyscanner city code (e.g. LOND).

no_cache.description: Bypass the 5-minute result cache and render a fresh search.

origin.description: Origin: IATA airport code (e.g. WAW) or Skyscanner city code (e.g. LOND = all London airports).

return_date.description: Return date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for a one-way search.

name: skyscanner_search_flights
title: Search Skyscanner flights
